safety_policy: ceilings are infinite-loop guards, never evidence of stagnation or architecture incapacity

stagnation.definition: Cumulative best validation accuracy at successive 2K boundaries; mean training CE in each disjoint window. Joint plateau compares each to the preceding window. Negative improvements count plateau. Either signal meeting its minimum resets the consecutive count. Threshold crossing takes priority over all stops.
stagnation.supervisor_binding: Approved before launch via contact_supervisor: disjoint 2000-update windows, two consecutive comparisons, earliest 6000; safety stops not stagnation.

recipe.continuity: same model, optimizer and training RNG across stages
recipe.data: fresh procedural at current depth; X3 frozen val pools; validation-only selection

checkpoint_policy.best: best-val chain per stage, bound by checkpoint hashes
checkpoint_policy.boundaries: entry and exit every stage; full optimizer + NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG
checkpoint_policy.capacity: existing X5 prune below 400GiB; retain all boundaries, each stage best, latest, every10K; audited pruning

retention: current and all lower registered depths at entry, every500, every exit

logistics.detach: nohup setsid per run; independent exclusive heartbeat lease; DONE or FAIL marker per run
logistics.wake: Supervisor-side supervised watcher exits after six DONE, or immediately nonzero on FAIL/dead PID; supervisor arms session wake. No wg services used.

throughput_calibration.purpose: operational estimate, no reported accuracy or learning inference
throughput_calibration.retention_eval: all lower val depths timed, scores discarded
throughput_calibration.projection: 2M updates at slowest depth rate, including eval+checkpoint every500, conservative against stage constraints; not a guaranteed walltime bound

claims: observations only; no superiority claims before completed growth curves; local single-GPU task probes, no DiLoCo/Slurm conformance; R16 evidence discipline only
